benchmarks.name: PRIMER3_GC_BOUNDED
benchmarks.description: Primer3 output primers must have GC content within 40-60% for a standard exon target.
benchmarks.ground_truth: Default Primer3 design targets GC 20-80% with optimal 50%; 40-60% is standard for real-time PCR.
benchmarks.citation: Untergasser A. et al. Nucleic Acids Res. 2012 (Primer3).
